criteria.statement: Change classification: an empty diff over the explicit path list returns no-op, a non-empty diff returns changed
On the no-op path the injected commit/push/PR-open functions are never called and the local branch is deleted
On the changed path the injected commit/push/PR-open functions are each called exactly once, in order
A pipeline failure prevents any commit/push/PR-open call and leaves the local branch undeleted
node --test scripts/refresh-and-open-pr.test.mjs passes covering B1-B4, with no real refresh/build/git-network call
